title: Postural stability and body weight distribution in sportsmen
author: Jitka Marencakova
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qp8dvrw
materials: Use 2D analysis software for Chippaux-Smirak Index calculation from saved footprints following the Guidelines .

steps.title: Perform Postural Stability Measurements
steps.instruction: Conduct the measuring process according to the specified stance guidelines.

substeps.instruction: Perform 60 s of one-leg stance using the second leg

steps.title: Register Measurement Data
steps.instruction: Record the specific metrics for each stance test.

substeps.instruction: Register the percentage of body weight distribution from the narrow stance test
Register the total travelled way of COP during the one-leg stance test for both legs

steps.title: Save Footprint Data
steps.instruction: Save the footprints obtained from the one-leg stance tests for both legs.

steps.title: Repeat Tests and Provide Rest
steps.instruction: Repeat each test 3 times, ensuring the participant rests for 60 s in a relaxed position after every test.
